data.title: Goldman Sachs Bitcoin ETF: $2.25 Billion NEOS Deal Explained
data.description: Goldman Sachs is buying bitcoin ETF manager NEOS for up to $2.25 billion, a deal Bloomberg's Eric Balchunas says lets it 'leap frog' BlackRock's rival fund.
